# doit_role (Data Source)

Manage user permissions and access levels in your organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a custom role
resource "doit_role" "example" {
  name        = "Example Role"
  description = "Example role for data source lookup"
}

# Look up the role by ID using the data source
data "doit_role" "example" {
  id = doit_role.example.id
}

output "role_name" {
  value = data.doit_role.example.name
}

output "role_type" {
  value = data.doit_role.example.type
}

output "role_permissions" {
  value = data.doit_role.example.permissions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the role.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `child_tenant_eligible` (Boolean) Whether the owning tenant made this role available as a child tenant role.
- `customer` (String) The customer ID if this is a custom role. An empty string for a preset role.
- `description` (String) The description of the role. An empty string when no description is set.
- `name` (String) The name of the role.
- `permissions` (List of String) Permission IDs in stored order. An empty array when no permissions are assigned.
- `type` (String) The type of the role (preset or custom).

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
